cohort: 100 newborns admitted to the NICU of a tertiary teaching hospital in Odisha, India between October 2014 and October 2016.
finding: A high incidence of hearing loss was found in NICU-admitted newborns, with several risk factors including prematurity, very low birth weight, ototoxic medication, hyperbilirubinemia, sepsis, birth asphyxia, mechanical ventilation, ear abnormality, and congenital infection being significantly associated with abnormal OAE and BERA test results.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight mentioned as a risk factor, but no specific range given
